name: Mailjet
label: Mailjet — Mailjet Email v3.1 + SMS v4
description: Mailjet via the official Mailjet Email v3.1 + SMS v4. Base https://api.mailjet.com. Docs: https://dev.mailjet.com/email/reference/send-emails/ and https://dev.mailjet.com/sms/reference/overview/authentication/. send-email takes From/To/Subject/TextPart/HTMLPart nested into Messages[0] via bodyMap. Email uses Basic api_key:api_secret (v3.1). send-sms (POST /v4/sms-send) overrides Authorization with Bearer {sms_token}. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Mailjet operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"send-email"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-email | send-email-template | send-sms | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: Messages
schema.description: v3.1 one-message object escape hatch merged into Messages[0]. Named From/To/Subject/TextPart/HTMLPart win. Example: {"From":{"Email":"ada@example.com"},"To":[{"Email":"bob@example.com"}],"Subject":"Hi"}.

schema.label: From
schema.description: Email From.Email (send-email / send-email-template) or SMS originator (send-sms). Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: To
schema.description: Email To[0].Email (send-email / send-email-template) or SMS E.164 destination (send-sms). Example: bob@example.com.

schema.label: Text
schema.description: SMS body for send-sms. Official Text.

schema.label: FromName
schema.description: send-email From.Name. Wired to Messages[0].From.Name. Example: Ada.

schema.label: Subject
schema.description: send-email / send-email-template subject. Wired to Messages[0].Subject.

schema.label: TextPart
schema.description: send-email plain body. Wired to Messages[0].TextPart.

schema.label: HTMLPart
schema.description: send-email HTML body. Wired to Messages[0].HTMLPart.

schema.label: TemplateID
schema.description: send-email-template Mailjet template id. Wired to Messages[0].TemplateID.

schema.label: Variables
schema.description: send-email-template template variables object. Wired to Messages[0].Variables.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-email, send-email-template, send-sms, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: API secret
configurationParameters.description: Mailjet Secret Key. HTTP Basic api_key:api_secret. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: API key (email Basic username)
configurationParameters.description: Mailjet API Key used as HTTP Basic username, paired with api_secret. Email v3.1 only. Not the SMS Bearer token. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: SMS Bearer token
configurationParameters.description: Mailjet SMS v4 access token from the SMS Dashboard. send-sms sends Authorization: Bearer {sms_token} and overrides email Basic. Required for send-sms; omit for email-only. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
